name: Midnight Ran
source:
Ran and Kouji met on a dating site. 
Despite the awkwardness of their first meet, they had sex. 
Then a fight turned things sour and Kouji hurt Ran. 

She fled from him as tears streamed down her face. He followed. 

But the horrifying thing that happened next...
